outcome: Postpartum severe maternal morbidity and mortality
Frequency of maternal early warning criteria
cohort: Women who experienced severe maternal morbidity and mortality from delivery hospitalization discharge until 42 days postpartum (cases) and matched controls
finding: Maternal early warning criteria during postpartum assessments were strongly associated with increased odds of subsequent severe maternal morbidity and mortality.
mod_finding: Women who delivered by cesarean section had higher odds of postpartum severe maternal morbidity and mortality.
